settings.cpuThreadsMeaning: requested ONNX Runtime intra-op and native C CPU thread limit; not applied to single-threaded VolvoxAI WASM

onnxruntime.affinityPolicy: inherited; not pinned by benchmark harness

nativeC.affinityPolicy: inherited; not pinned by benchmark harness

volvoxaiWasm.hostRuntimeAuxiliaryThreads: Node/V8 auxiliary threads are not counted or limited by the harness; they share the process's inherited CPU affinity

childProcessEnvironment.policy: inherit non-Volvox variables, remove every uppercase VOLVOX* runtime override, then force the common CPU thread-limit variables
childProcessEnvironment.scope: all native C and VolvoxAI WASM qualification, warmup, and measured children

settings.dynamicShapeQualification: untimed canonical short/grow/maximum-padded/shrink sequence; one fresh process per native CPU/WASM precision entry, each reusing one runtime/session and the same encoder/decoder contexts
settings.sampleIsolation: fresh ONNX Runtime encoder/decoder sessions in the persistent Python harness process; fresh child process and runtime for each native C and VolvoxAI WASM request
settings.graphInspectionScope: one non-executing ORT CPU session per source graph serializes the optimized graph before warmup; inspection is outside all timings
settings.warmupScope: discarded full matrices; ONNX Runtime sessions and native C/WASM child processes are not reused, while the Python harness process, loaded ONNX Runtime library/global state, OS page cache, and host thermal/frequency state persist
settings.timingScope: encoder and one-token decoder execution only; package/model loading, compilation, preprocessing, tokenization, and process startup excluded
settings.runOrderPolicy: deterministic forward/reverse pairs, rotating the first tier by one position after every pair; warmup and measured matrices share one continuous matrix index
